fields.Name: Ask-First Deflection
fields.Description: Pre-submission search deflection across already-solved Q&A answers (and, when supplied, Living Documents) in the forums the member may read. Scores the best match with a deterministic keyword-overlap rubric — graceful fallback when no vector/AI search service is wired in — and declines to deflect when nothing clears MinConfidence.
fields.UserPrompt: Search for an existing answer before posting a new question.

fields.Name: QueryText
fields.Description: The member's draft question text to search against.

fields.Name: AllowedForumIDs
fields.Description: Comma-separated list of Forum IDs the requesting member may read. Computed by the caller; this action performs no permission checks of its own.

fields.Name: MinConfidence
fields.Description: Minimum confidence (0-1) required to deflect. Default 0.35.

fields.Name: MaxCitations
fields.Description: Maximum number of citations to return. Default 3.

fields.Name: Deflected
fields.Description: Whether an existing answer was confident enough to deflect the new post.

fields.Name: ConfidenceScore
fields.Description: Confidence score (0-1) of the best match.

fields.Name: SynthesizedAnswerMarkdown
fields.Description: The best-matching answer's body, when deflected; null otherwise.

fields.Name: Citations
fields.Description: JSON array of AskFirstCitation (postId, forumSlug, title, authorDisplayName, epistemicStatus, confidenceScore).

fields.Name: SuggestedPostTypeCode
fields.Description: PostType code to use if the member posts anyway.

fields.Name: SuggestedTitle
fields.Description: Suggested title if the member posts anyway, derived from QueryText.
A confident existing answer was found.
No sufficiently confident match was found; the member should post.
QueryText was not supplied.
No context user.

fields.Name: Epistemic Answer Grading
fields.Description: Grades a Q&A answer against its question (and, when supplied, the forum's existing canon answer) using a deterministic rubric — no LLM call required. Writes AIEpistemicStatus, AIConfidenceScore, and AIRationaleMarkdown; sets VerificationStatus to 'AI_Verified' only at or above 0.85 confidence.
fields.UserPrompt: Grade this answer's epistemic status and confidence.

fields.Name: AnswerPostID
fields.Description: ID of the Forum Answer Post to grade. When supplied, the action loads the authoritative Question/Answer body markdown from the database (QuestionBodyMarkdown/AnswerBodyMarkdown become optional overrides) and persists AIEpistemicStatus/AIConfidenceScore back onto this Answer Post.

fields.Name: QuestionBodyMarkdown
fields.Description: The question's body markdown. Required unless AnswerPostID is supplied, in which case it is loaded from the database and this is an optional override.

fields.Name: AnswerBodyMarkdown
fields.Description: The answer's body markdown to grade. Required unless AnswerPostID is supplied, in which case it is loaded from the database and this is an optional override.

fields.Name: PriorCanonAnswerMarkdown
fields.Description: The question's existing accepted/canon answer, if any, used to detect a conflicting new answer.

fields.Name: ConfidenceScore
fields.Description: Confidence score from 0.000 to 1.000.

fields.Name: EpistemicStatus
fields.Description: One of 'Canon Verified', 'Novel Insight', 'Partially Outdated', 'Conflicts With Canon'.

fields.Name: VerificationStatus
fields.Description: 'AI_Verified' at or above 0.85 confidence; 'Needs_Human_Review' otherwise.

fields.Name: CitationReferences
fields.Description: JSON array of citation URLs extracted from the answer.

fields.Name: RationaleMarkdown
fields.Description: Human-readable explanation of the grading.
The answer was graded.
QuestionBodyMarkdown or AnswerBodyMarkdown was not supplied.
No context user.

fields.Name: Living Thread Synthesis
fields.Description: Synthesizes a root post's executive summary (SummaryMarkdown / AIExecutiveSummary) using the managed 'Community: Living Thread Synthesis' AI Prompt (Gemini 3.5 Flash-Lite), caching the result on ForumPost and regenerating only when the thread content or replies change (or when ForceRegenerate is true).
fields.UserPrompt: Generate or return the cached AI executive summary for this thread.

fields.Name: RootPostID
fields.Description: ID of the root ForumPost to synthesize.

fields.Name: AcceptedAnswerPostID
fields.Description: ID of the thread's accepted answer, if any, surfaced first as a Key Resolution.

fields.Name: MaxReplyCount
fields.Description: Bounds how many replies are considered. Default 50.

fields.Name: MaxCharsPerPost
fields.Description: Bounds how many characters of each post are included. Default 500.

fields.Name: ForceRegenerate
fields.Description: When 'true', bypasses the cached summary on ForumPost and regenerates via AI Prompt.

fields.Name: AIExecutiveSummary
fields.Description: The synthesized executive-summary markdown.

fields.Name: AISynthesizedAt
fields.Description: ISO timestamp of this synthesis run.

fields.Name: ConsideredReplyCount
fields.Description: How many replies were actually included after bounding.

fields.Name: KeyTakeaways
fields.Description: JSON array of key takeaway bullet strings with inline contributor citations.

fields.Name: OpenQuestions
fields.Description: JSON array of open questions with inline contributor citations.

fields.Name: ContributorCitations
fields.Description: JSON array of contributor citation objects ({ citationIndex, authorDisplayName, postId, roleLabel }).

fields.Name: CacheHit
fields.Description: True when an up-to-date cached summary on ForumPost was returned without invoking the LLM.

fields.Name: ModelUsed
fields.Description: Display name of the AI model used to synthesize the summary (or 'Deterministic' when offline).
The thread was synthesized.
RootPostID was not supplied.
No post exists with the given RootPostID.
No context user.

fields.Name: Export Community Digest PDF
fields.Description: Renders a member's Community Digest as a real server-side PDF via pdfkit (never window.print()), scoped to AllowedForumIDs and hard-capped at 100 items, returned as a base64 string output parameter.
fields.UserPrompt: Export my community digest as a PDF.

fields.Name: SpaceName
fields.Description: Display name of the Community Space, used in the PDF header.

fields.Name: AllowedForumIDs
fields.Description: Comma-separated list of Forum IDs the requesting member may read. Computed by the caller; an empty list yields an empty digest rather than an error.

fields.Name: MaxItems
fields.Description: Caller's own cap on included items; can only tighten, never widen, the hard 100-item ceiling.

fields.Name: PDFBase64
fields.Description: The generated PDF, base64-encoded.

fields.Name: ItemCount
fields.Description: Number of digest items actually included (after the 100-item cap).

fields.Name: ByteLength
fields.Description: Size of the generated PDF in bytes.
The PDF was generated.
SpaceName was not supplied.
No context user.

fields.Name: Send Personalized Community Digest
fields.Description: Ranks recent community threads for each authorized recipient using CommunityEmbeddingPersonalizationService, enforces Collaboration Space, Forum, and Team-band permissions, issues compact RFC 5321 <= 64-octet HMAC-SHA256 Reply-To tokens, and dispatches via MemberJunction CommunicationEngine.

fields.Name: SpaceID
fields.Description: Optional Collaboration Space UUID to scope candidate forums.

fields.Name: AllowedForumIDs
fields.Description: Comma-separated list of Forum UUIDs eligible for digest ranking.

fields.Name: RecipientUserIDs
fields.Description: Comma-separated list of User UUIDs to receive personalized digests (defaults to ContextUser).

fields.Name: UseTestDriver
fields.Description: Whether to use the Community Test Email Driver when CommunicationEngine is unconfigured.

fields.Name: DryRun
fields.Description: When true, records DryRun=true on dispatched messages without external delivery.

fields.Name: ProviderName
fields.Description: Communication provider name override (e.g., Community Test Email Driver or SendGrid).

fields.Name: CommunityName
fields.Description: Display name of the community used in the digest subject and header.

fields.Name: MaxItemsPerDigest
fields.Description: Maximum number of ranked threads to include per recipient digest (default 5, max 25).

fields.Name: SentCount
fields.Description: Number of personalized digests dispatched successfully.

fields.Name: FailedCount
fields.Description: Number of recipient deliveries that failed or were denied by permissions.

fields.Name: ProviderNameUsed
fields.Description: Name of the communication provider used for dispatch.

fields.Name: DeliveriesJSON
fields.Description: JSON array of per-recipient delivery summaries including issued Reply-To addresses.

fields.Name: Process Inbound Community Digest Reply
fields.Description: Cryptographically verifies compact HMAC-SHA256 Reply-To tokens, strips quoted email history and signature chrome, enforces Space/Forum/Role reply permissions, and persists inbound replies as child Forum Posts.
fields.UserPrompt: Process an inbound email reply to a community digest thread.

fields.Name: ReplyToAddress
fields.Description: Inbound Reply-To email address containing the signed compact reply token.

fields.Name: ReplyToken
fields.Description: Raw compact reply token if supplied outside a full email address.

fields.Name: RawBodyText
fields.Description: Raw inbound email body text before stripping quoted history and signatures.

fields.Name: SenderEmail
fields.Description: Sender email address verified against the token recipient binding.

fields.Name: PostID
fields.Description: UUID of the newly persisted child reply Forum Post.

fields.Name: ForumID
fields.Description: UUID of the target Forum.

fields.Name: RootPostID
fields.Description: UUID of the root thread Forum Post.

fields.Name: CleanedBodyMarkdown
fields.Description: Reply body markdown after stripping quoted history and email signatures.
